name: weighted plate deadlift rear lunge with overhead press
description: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.
